name: Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Landaa Giraavaru
insider_take: This UNESCO Biosphere Reserve paradise isn't just another luxury retreat—it's a marine conservation sanctuary where you can swim alongside manta rays and whale sharks while contributing to groundbreaking ocean research.
whats_special: The resort sits on a 44-hectare island in Baa Atoll, home to the world's largest population of manta rays. The on-site Marine Discovery Centre conducts vital research on these gentle giants, and guests can participate in tagging expeditions. The resort also features the Maldives' only UNESCO Biosphere Reserve location and operates a sea turtle rehabilitation program.
pro_tip: Book your stay between May and November for peak manta ray season at nearby Hanifaru Bay—you'll witness hundreds of these majestic creatures feeding in what's considered one of the world's greatest wildlife spectacles.
dont_miss: The overwater spa treatments at sunrise, snorkeling at the house reef teeming with sharks and rays, and the complimentary marine biologist-led excursions to witness whale shark feeding frenzies during plankton blooms.
pros: UNESCO Biosphere Reserve location with exceptional marine life and coral reefs
Award-winning marine conservation center and sea turtle rehabilitation program
Overwater and beach villas with private pools and direct ocean access
World-class spa treatments in overwater pavilions with glass floor panels
